_metadata.description: Electrolyte equilibrium reactions auto-generated from electrolyte.xml plus a curated list of common aqueous-process equilibria. Reaction type is Equilibrium, ReactionBasis is Activity, and K is computed by DWSIM at runtime from compound Gibbs energies of formation (KExprType = Gibbs). For informational purposes, ΔG_rxn at 298 K is included where all standard formation values are known.
_metadata.ion_charge_convention: Ion formula matches what the host electrolyte.xml database uses; the loader normalizes between SO4-2 / SO42- variants.
_metadata.phase_convention: Liquid = aqueous solution. Solid-phase salt-precipitation reactions can be added later by extending this file.
